item.title: Indosat, Ooredoo Group, Nokia, NVIDIA Launch Zankore by Indosat AI Infrastructure Platform
item.summary: Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison (Indosat), Ooredoo Group, Nokia, and NVIDIA have launched Zankore by Indosat, an artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure platform that aims to expand AI computing capacity in Southeast Asia and support efforts to position Indonesia as a regional AI hub. Related: Indosat Targets AI-Driven Growth with Vikram Sinha Tenure Extension The companies said the platform […] The post Indosat, Ooredoo Group, Nokia, NVIDIA Launch Zankore by Indosat AI Infrastructure Platform appeared first on Telecom Review Asia .
